Metadata.title: Eau de Fragrances — your perfume collection
Metadata.description: Catalogue the perfumes you own, keep a wishlist of what to buy next, and jump to Fragrantica and Parfumo for every scent.

Home.title: Every bottle you own. Every bottle you want.
Home.subtitle: Catalogue your perfume collection, keep a wishlist of what to buy next, and jump straight to Fragrantica and Parfumo for every scent.
Home.featuresTitle: Built for the way collectors think

collection.title: Your collection
collection.body: Every bottle in one place, with concentration, year and your own rating.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.body: Save what you want to try or buy next, then move it to your collection the day it arrives.

ratings.title: Fragrantica & Parfumo
ratings.body: One click to each perfume on both platforms, plus the average rating from our own community.

prices.title: Best price in Bulgaria
prices.body: Coming soon: the lowest current price across Bulgarian shops for every perfume on your wishlist.
